title: 将用户上下文及其使用权还给用户

scenes.title: 开篇
scenes.cn: 你跟AI聊了三个月，帮它理解了你的代码库架构、你的命名习惯、你偏好的技术栈。然后你换了一个AI工具——一切归零。所有的默契、所有积累的上下文——都留在了上一个工具的服务器上。你创造了上下文，但你并不拥有它。
scenes.en: You chat with AI for three months. It learns your codebase, naming habits, tech stack. Then you switch tools — everything resets to zero. All the context you built — trapped on someone else's server. You created it. But you don't own it.

scenes.title: 本质问题
scenes.cn: 上下文，是AI时代最稀缺的生产资料。代码可以重写，但AI为什么这样改的推理链、上次踩过什么坑的经验——这些一旦丢失，无法重建。当今所有主流AI编程助手的共同架构：对话历史存储在服务商的云服务器上。你是租客，不是房东。
scenes.en: Context is the scarcest resource in the AI era. Code can be rewritten. But the reasoning chain — why the AI made that change, what pitfalls it hit — once lost, cannot be rebuilt. Every mainstream AI coding assistant stores your conversations on their cloud. You're a tenant. Not the owner.

scenes.title: ChatGPT的失败
scenes.cn: ChatGPT给你一个会话列表和搜索框。但只能搜标题——不能全文检索对话内容。导出是一次性JSON dump，没有工具链能消费。跨会话引用？不存在。你只能复制粘贴。上下文是活的、持续生长的——但ChatGPT把它当死的静态列表。
scenes.en: ChatGPT gives you a session list and a search box. But it only searches titles — never the full conversation. Export is a one-time JSON dump no toolchain can consume. Cross-session reference? Doesn't exist. You copy and paste. Context is alive, growing — but ChatGPT treats it as a dead, static list.

scenes.title: Claude和Copilot的失败
scenes.cn: Claude的Projects允许上传文件作为背景知识。但对话历史仍然不可全文检索。知识库需要手动维护——每次学到新东西，你得自己摘出来放进去。Copilot的聊天面板有历史，但仅限当前会话。每次从零开始，浪费token重复理解已理解过的东西。
scenes.en: Claude Projects lets you upload background knowledge. But conversation history still isn't searchable. Knowledge bases need manual upkeep — every insight, you catalogue yourself. Copilot keeps chat history, but only for the current session. Every conversation starts from zero, wasting tokens re-learning what was already learned.

scenes.title: Cursor和JetBrains的失败
scenes.cn: Cursor的代码库索引是最先进的。但聊天历史不支持全文检索，上下文不可导出、不可迁移。JetBrains AI完全绑定JetBrains生态。和所有云方案一样——你拥有的是访问权，不是所有权。
scenes.en: Cursor has the best codebase indexing. But chat history has no full-text search. Context can't be exported. Can't be migrated. JetBrains AI is locked into its ecosystem. Same as every cloud solution — you have access. Not ownership.

scenes.title: 三条铁律——全部违反
scenes.cn: 所有方案都违反三条铁律。第一，可检索——全文检索所有历史上下文，无一做到。第二，可迁移——开放格式可导入其他工具，无一做到。第三，可复用——新会话自动引用旧上下文，无一做到。根本错误：假设上下文是服务商的资产。
scenes.en: Every solution violates three iron laws. One: Searchable — full-text across all history. None achieve it. Two: Portable — open format importable to any tool. None achieve it. Three: Reusable — new sessions auto-reference old context. None achieve it. The root fallacy: assuming context belongs to the service provider.

scenes.title: 第一步：上下文存在哪里
scenes.cn: 我们的方案从最基础的问题开始：上下文应该存在哪里？三个追问：用户能随时拿到原始数据吗？数据格式是谁定义的？服务停止后数据还在吗？答案全部否定。结论：上下文必须和代码放在一起——物理上、格式上、控制权上。qqqide把所有上下文存在项目根目录的qqq文件夹里。拷贝项目，等于完整迁移所有AI对话历史。
scenes.en: We start from the most fundamental question: where should context live? Three questions: Can the user access raw data anytime? Who defines the format? Does data survive when the service dies? All answers: No. Conclusion: context must live with your code — physically, in format, in control. qqqide stores everything under the qqq directory. Copy the project, you copy all AI history.

scenes.title: 第二步：双轨制格式
scenes.cn: 确定了存哪里，下一个问题：存什么格式？我们拒绝单一格式，因为上下文有两种根本不同的消费者：机器需要结构化JSON来加载到上下文窗口，人类需要纯文本来grep、浏览、在记事本里打开。于是有了双轨制：all.json给机器，all.txt给人类。再加上reasoning.txt——工具结果截断到三百字，用于快速审计这层楼做了什么。
scenes.en: Location decided. Next: what format? We reject single format, because context has two fundamentally different consumers. Machines need structured JSON to load into context windows. Humans need plain text to grep, browse, open in Notepad. So we built dual-track: all.json for machines, all.txt for humans. Plus reasoning.txt — tool results truncated to 300 chars for rapid audit.

scenes.title: 第三步：层级目录
scenes.cn: 当有五十个任务、每个任务二十层楼时，怎么组织目录？我们定义了严格的层级：quest是一次对话，floor是一次回车，house是一次API调用，room是一次工具调用。每层楼是独立可寻址的最小单元。精确引用某一层，不需要加载整个任务。这为跨任务知识引用奠定了基础。
scenes.en: Fifty quests, twenty floors each — how to organize? We defined a strict hierarchy: quest is a conversation, floor is one user prompt, house is one API call, room is one tool call. Each floor is the smallest addressable unit. Reference one floor's full context without loading the entire quest. This lays the foundation for cross-quest knowledge referencing.

scenes.title: 第四步：全文检索
scenes.cn: 目录解决了怎么存，没解决怎么找。qqqide集成了ripgrep——Rust实现的高性能搜索引擎，直接对所有all.txt执行正则搜索，毫秒级返回。对比：ChatGPT和Claude只能搜标题，Cursor也只能搜标题。而我们搜全文，本地毫秒级，离线可用，支持正则。这不是更好的搜索框——这是把AI对话从聊天软件变成了你的私人知识库。
scenes.en: Directories solved storage, not discovery. qqqide integrates ripgrep — a Rust-powered search engine — scanning all all.txt with regex, returning in milliseconds. Compare: ChatGPT and Claude search titles only. Cursor, titles only. We search full text. Local. Millisecond. Offline. Regex. This isn't a better search box — it turns AI chat from messaging app into your personal knowledge base.

scenes.title: 第五步：Timeline因果链
scenes.cn: 有了对话的存储和检索，下一个问题：这些对话产生了哪些代码？反过来，这段代码是哪次对话产生的？我们自建了timeline版本系统。每次AI工具调用完成时，自动捕获文件快照并打上trace标记——精确到哪个任务、第几层楼、第几次调用。点开diff窗口，看到代码变更，点击来源，跳转到当时的完整推理。Git blame知道谁改的——trace知道为什么改。
scenes.en: With conversations stored and searchable: which code came from which conversation? Which conversation produced this line? We built a timeline version system. Every AI tool call captures a file snapshot with a trace marker — pinpointing which quest, which floor, which call. Open the diff window, see a change, click source — jump to the full reasoning. Git blame knows who. Trace knows why.

scenes.title: 第六步：跨任务上下文协作
scenes.cn: 前五步都是基础设施。第六步是它们共同支撑的核心：跨任务上下文协作。你在任务八中需要参考之前的数据库设计——ripgrep搜索关键词，毫秒定位到任务一的第三层楼。打开all.txt，看到当时的完整结论和决策。然后在任务八中说「参考那个设计继续」——AI读取all.json，看到完整上下文，知道约束、决策、踩过的坑。甚至可以直接开分支：基于旧任务全部成果，尝试全新方向。这种能力，只有拥有一切原料时才可能存在。
scenes.en: Five steps of infrastructure. Step six is what they enable: cross-quest context collaboration. You're on quest eight, need that database design from quest one. Ripgrep finds it in milliseconds. Open all.txt — the full reasoning is there. Tell the AI 'continue from that design'. It reads all.json, understands constraints, decisions, pitfalls. You can even fork: take all context from an old quest, try a new direction. This capability only exists when you own every raw material.

scenes.title: 第七步：预渲染
scenes.cn: 最后一步消除摩擦。每次重启IDE都重新渲染对话HTML，用户会感觉卡。我们在all.json中引入预渲染字段——流式渲染完成后，将最终DOM序列化并持久化。重启时直接读出，零重新渲染，零等待。你拥有的不仅是对话的文本内容，还有对话的完整视觉呈现。
scenes.en: The final step eliminates friction. Restarting the IDE shouldn't re-render every conversation. We introduced a pre-render field in all.json — after streaming, serialize the final DOM and persist it. On restart, direct innerHTML — zero re-render, zero wait. You don't just own the text. You own the complete visual presentation of your conversations.

scenes.title: 核心突破：一切原料
scenes.cn: 回看七步，核心命题只有一个：跨任务上下文协作的前提，是拥有一切原料。一场AI对话产生的全部信息——完整对话的JSON和TXT、审计摘要、代码快照、变更索引、因果链trace、预渲染HTML、任务元信息——一共八项。云方案最多给你两项。我们给你全部八项，在你自己的硬盘上，开放格式。所有能力差异的根源，不是我们做得更好——而是我们拥有原料。
scenes.en: Looking back, one core thesis: cross-quest context collaboration is only possible when you own every raw material. Everything an AI conversation produces — JSON, TXT, audit summaries, code snapshots, change indexes, trace chains, pre-rendered HTML, quest metadata — eight artifacts. Cloud gives you at most two. qqqide gives you all eight, on your drive, open format. Every capability gap: not that we do it better — we own the materials.

scenes.title: 两种上下文哲学
scenes.cn: 云哲学认为，上下文是服务的附属品。你付费获得访问权，服务终止，上下文蒸发。本地哲学认为，上下文是你的财产。你创造它，你拥有它，你控制它。工具只是帮你在本地管理它。这是两种完全不同的世界观。
scenes.en: The cloud philosophy: context is a service add-on. You pay for access. Service ends, context evaporates. The local philosophy: context is your property. You created it. You own it. You control it. The tool just helps you manage it. Two fundamentally different worldviews.

scenes.title: 上下文是AI时代的源代码
scenes.cn: 代码开源运动用了三十年让「代码应该属于写它的人」成为共识。AI时代面临同样的问题——只是资产从代码变成了上下文。今天所有AI工具都在做同一件事：用免费服务换取你的上下文数据。你越用，积累越多；积累越多，迁移成本越高。这不是技术选择，这是商业锁定。qqqide在根本架构上拒绝这个模式。
scenes.en: Open source took thirty years to establish that code belongs to its creators. AI era, same question — asset shifts from code to context. Every AI tool trades free service for your context data. Use more, accumulate more. Accumulate more, harder to leave. Not a technical choice. Vendor lock-in. qqqide rejects this model at the architectural level.

scenes.title: 结论
scenes.cn: 我们把AI上下文从云端的服务附属品，变成了本地的用户财产。七步递进：本地存储、双轨格式、层级目录、全文检索、因果链追溯、跨任务协作、预渲染。核心洞察只有一个：你只有拥有一切原料，才能真正使用它们。全文检索、跨任务引用、因果追溯、任务分支——这些不是高级功能，而是用户对自己数据的基本权利。我们只是把这些权利，从服务商手里拿回来，还给了用户。
scenes.en: We turned AI context from cloud service add-on into local user property. Seven progressive steps: local storage, dual-track format, hierarchical directories, full-text search, trace causality, cross-quest collaboration, pre-rendering. The core insight: you can only truly use what you fully own. Full-text search, cross-quest referencing, causal tracing, task forking — not premium features. Basic rights over your own data. We took those rights back from service providers and returned them to you.
